\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, grammar; \hyperref[ch:ka-core-verbs]{Chapter~32, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-core-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to be, to stay, to live}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಇರು}}\enspace(iru)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: script, grammar, etymology; \hyperref[ch:first-verbs]{Chapter~5, p.~\pageref*{ch:first-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to eat — and the middle bead, which carries the past but does not bother to separate the future}\enspace\emph{\kn{ತಿನ್ನು}}\enspace(tinnu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: grammar; \hyperref[ch:ka-core-verbs]{Chapter~32, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-core-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to go — and the one sound-law that separates Kannada from all three of its sisters}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಹೋಗು}}\enspace(hōgu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: etymology; \hyperref[ch:ka-core-verbs]{Chapter~32, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-core-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to go (and \kn{ಬಾ}, come)}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಹೋಗು}}\enspace(hōgu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, script, etymology; \hyperref[ch:farewells]{Chapter~4, p.~\pageref*{ch:farewells}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to help — literally \textquotedblleft{}help-do,\textquotedblright{} a Sanskrit noun in front of a native Dravidian verb, and the single most useful thing you can say to a stranger}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಸಹಾಯ} \kn{ಮಾಡು}}\enspace(sahāya māḍu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, etymology; \hyperref[ch:ka-social-verbs]{Chapter~34, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-social-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to read, to study — an inherited Dravidian word that once meant reciting aloud, and that Kannada alone kept in the everyday job}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಓದು}}\enspace(ōdu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, etymology; \hyperref[ch:ka-mind-verbs]{Chapter~33, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-mind-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to see, to look — the third slot, and the one everyday word the four sisters do NOT share}\enspace\emph{\kn{ನೋಡು}}\enspace(nōḍu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: grammar, etymology; \hyperref[ch:ka-core-verbs]{Chapter~32, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-core-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to speak}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಮಾತನಾಡು}}\enspace(mātanāḍu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, script, grammar, etymology; \hyperref[ch:first-verbs]{Chapter~5, p.~\pageref*{ch:first-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to take — \textquotedblleft{}having pulled it out, keep it for yourself,\textquotedblright{} a two-verb design all three Dravidian sisters share where English has one flat word}\enspace\emph{\kn{ತೆಗೆದುಕೊ}}\enspace(tegeduko)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, etymology; \hyperref[ch:ka-social-verbs]{Chapter~34, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-social-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to think — a Sanskrit noun wearing Kannada's own verb-making suffix, beside the inherited root Kannada kept for remembering}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಯೋಚಿಸು}}\enspace(yōcisu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, grammar, etymology; \hyperref[ch:ka-mind-verbs]{Chapter~33, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-mind-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to understand — \textquotedblleft{}meaning, having done, take for yourself,\textquotedblright{} three pieces in a row, and the ending that hands an action back to its doer}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊ}}\enspace(arthamāḍiko)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: pronunciation, grammar, etymology; \hyperref[ch:ka-mind-verbs]{Chapter~33, p.~\pageref*{ch:ka-mind-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
\raggedright
\textbf{to work (lit. \textquotedblleft{}work-do\textquotedblright{})}\enspace\emph{\kn{ಕೆಲಸ} \kn{ಮಾಡು}}\enspace(kelasa māḍu)\par
\footnotesize explicit focus: script, grammar, etymology; \hyperref[ch:first-verbs]{Chapter~5, p.~\pageref*{ch:first-verbs}}
\end{minipage}\par\smallskip

\noindent\begin{minipage}[t]{\linewidth}
